hero.preTitle: A New Era in Niche Perfumery
hero.title: Rise With Fenix
hero.subtitle: More than fragrances — an empire. We build the relationships, intelligence, experiences, summits, and investments that are reshaping niche perfumery from Latin America to the world.

pillars.title: Five Pillars of Fenix
pillars.subtitle: Fenix is building the infrastructure for the next era of niche perfumery — from relationships to capital.

items.title: Fenix Network
items.desc: A living ecosystem of relationships across four layers — Founders, Retail, Culture, and Experience — connecting niche fragrance brands with luxury retailers, influencers, and cultural venues worldwide.

items.title: Fenix Intelligence
items.desc: Structured market intelligence that nobody else in niche perfumery is producing. Industry reports, consumer insights, and trend analysis that position Fenix as the global authority.

items.title: Fenix Experiences
items.desc: We don't do events. We create universes. Immersive Scent & Sound Sessions blending fragrance, music, gastronomy, and visual art — quarterly in London, expanding globally.

items.title: Fenix Summit
items.desc: The Davos of niche perfumery. A curated two-day global forum bringing together founders, investors, retailers, and culture — where business meets art meets neuroscience.

items.title: Fenix Capital
items.desc: The natural deal flow of the ecosystem. From advisory and equity partnerships with emerging brands to a full venture studio and investment fund for niche fragrance.

founder.title: Marcelo Capote
founder.intro: Behind Fenix stands Marcelo Capote — a visionary who understood that the biggest asset in niche perfumery isn't content, it's relationships. He is building the empire that connects Latin American fragrance talent with the world's most discerning markets.
founder.p1: Growing up in Brazil, Marcelo was surrounded by the intoxicating aromas of the Atlantic Forest — vanilla orchids, tonka beans drying under the Bahian sun, and the sweet resinous scent of copaíba. While others saw ingredients, he saw an industry waiting to be connected.
founder.p2: His path took him from São Paulo to Grasse and then to London, where he realized that niche perfumery lacked what every great industry needs: infrastructure. No structured intelligence. No curated events. No real network connecting founders to retail to culture to capital.
founder.p3: That realization became Fenix: not a single brand, but a complete ecosystem — network, intelligence, experiences, summits, and investment — designed to discover, elevate, and scale the next generation of niche fragrance houses.
founder.p4: His philosophy is simple: your biggest asset isn't content — it's relationships. Fenix is the bridge between the world's most talented noses and the markets, investors, and cultural moments that will define the future of scent.
founder.quote: The phoenix doesn't announce its rebirth. It simply appears.
founder.quoteName: — Marcelo Capote, Founder & CEO, Fenix Fragrance Holdings

products.title: Fenix Fragrances
products.subtitle: Our flagship collection — each scent tells a chapter of Brazil's sweet aromatic story, crafted for the sophisticated European palate.

items.name: Doce Amazônia
items.description: A lush, intoxicating journey through the Amazon canopy. Sweet vanilla orchid meets tropical fruit and deep woody musks.

items.name: Bahia Dourada
items.description: Sun-kissed tonka bean and salted caramel evoke the golden beaches of Bahia. Warm, addictive, unforgettable.

items.name: Noite Carioca
items.description: The electric sweetness of a Rio night. Dark chocolate and exotic fruits dance with smoky vetiver and precious woods.

items.name: Flor de Ipê
items.description: Delicate yet bold, like the iconic yellow Ipê flower. Sweet honey notes wrapped in soft florals and creamy woods.
